title: TOO EXPENSIVE FOR WHAT U GET
text:
TOO EXPENSIVE FOR WHAT U GET. I was so excited to get these lanterns... especially for the money they cost.
The outside of the boxes were fine, no damage.
Both doors were jammed into the lantern and I had to pry them open.
Corners don't meet evenly. The doors are very flimsy. If these go outside they will have every spider in the neighborhood and there's no way to stop the water from drenching whatever candle you place inside.
I'm so frickin mad I could scream and I would rather toss them out after I throw them across the room instead of sending them back.
I've never done a review being this angry before...I'm pisd! .......
